$comment: Checks run on every composed reply before it reaches the customer. Phrases are matched case-insensitively as substrings; leakPatterns are regex (same dialect rules as injection-patterns.json, flags 'i'). Any violation replaces the reply with the matching template from reply-templates.json and adds the REPLY_GUARD_FALLBACK flag. Violation codes: TOO_LONG, EMPTY, CONTRADICTS_DECISION, LEAKS_INTERNALS, WRONG_AMOUNT.
amountRule: If the decision is approved, every dollar amount in the reply (pattern \$\s?[\d,]+(\.\d{2})?) must equal the decision amount formatted as {amount}. If the decision is denied or escalated, the reply must not contain any dollar amount. Violation code WRONG_AMOUNT.
